parallel.requirements: Recognized the prompt as a black-box C++ to Rust port requiring std-only Rust 2021, test11.rs at /output, Cargo structure, exact CLI argv behavior, and byte-for-byte output.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent retained implementation and artifact ownership while delegating read-only API characterization slices to ten workflow subagents across probe and adversarial phases.
parallel.implementation: Parent wrote Cargo.toml, a module tree under src/inflection, byte helpers, rule tables, a regex engine, inflection functions, ordinal/atoi logic, and test11.rs.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Parent integrated its own modules into the entry point, built /output/test11 with rustc, and status artifact validation recorded Cargo files, test11.rs, executable, and module files.
parallel.verification: Parent ran documented examples and a local differential harness, fixed empty-string pluralize, reached 768/768 identical outputs, and official evaluation later passed 40/40.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The workflow was killed with one adversarial parameterize child still in progress and the final response was empty, but the delivered artifact passed official evaluation.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same black-box C++ to Rust task, no external crates, exact argv and byte-output behavior, Cargo project, test11.rs, and executable requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Single agent owned probing, implementation, integration, testing, and patching without delegation or child-agent handoffs.
serial.implementation: Serial wrote Cargo.toml, src/lib.rs, ascii/cstdlib/rules/inflector modules, and test11.rs with a simpler direct implementation of observed behavior.
serial.integration_and_delivery: After a module-path compile error, serial patched imports, rebuilt /output/test11, and status artifact validation recorded the expected root entry, executable, and module files.
serial.verification: Serial used extensive black-box probes, brute-force suffix scans, a 41531-line corpus generator, differential testing, then fixed the one observed news mismatch.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The final full differential rerun was killed with exit 137 as the process timed out, and final.txt is empty, but the patched artifact passed official evaluation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel identified the required exact Rust port, no crates, /output project structure, test11.rs entry, and byte-for-byte C++ behavior.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial identified the same exact port requirements and worked from the same prompt and binary.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-coverage difference at closure; both recognized and delivered the required artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed characterization into workflow probe and adversarial children while the parent owned implementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept all probing, implementation, verification, and patching in one agent.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel used child agents only for read-only specification discovery; serial performed the same discovery locally.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs included the binary path, line map, known facts, read-only rule, and structured report schema.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child interface, so all facts remained in one context and were applied directly.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had explicit research handoff boundaries, but they were specification reports rather than interoperating implementation components.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote a richer module tree including a miniature regex engine and inflection submodules.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a smaller direct implementation and patched simplified isPlural handling after finding news mismatches.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The implementation designs differ internally, but both matched the evaluator-visible behavior.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel workflow returned all seven probe reports and two adversarial reports, but the aggregate workflow ended killed with one adversarial child still in progress.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; its last visible action was a killed final differential rerun after the news fix.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had an incomplete child-workflow tail, whereas serial had no child result to join; neither incomplete tail changed the official artifact outcome.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children were instructed not to write; the parent alone wrote and assembled the final Cargo project and executable.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a single shared project itself and patched files in place after compile and differential feedback.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No evidence of parallel shared-state collisions or child artifact contamination; integration ownership was effectively parent-only.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran documented examples, local differential tests, and the official evaluator completed 40/40 passing cases.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran probes, brute-force scans, differential corpora, fixed the observed news mismatch, and the official evaluator completed 40/40 passing cases.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both had strong acceptance evidence; parallel's final workflow did not complete, but its artifact was already differentially checked and officially accepted.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed a 2399-second budget and timed out, killing the workflow and leaving final.txt empty after artifact creation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also consumed a 2399-second budget and timed out during a final differential rerun, leaving final.txt empty after artifact creation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both processes timed out, but the parallel timeout uniquely interrupted child workflow work; neither timeout prevented artifact validation or official pass.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluations are not discordant: both artifacts passed all 40 testcases. Parallel reached a correct artifact through parent implementation plus child-agent characterization, while serial reached a correct artifact through single-agent probing and a later news fix. The visible process difference is coordination overhead and a killed parallel workflow, not a delivered-behavior difference.
parallel_contributors: Parent retained implementation ownership and produced the Cargo project and executable before timeout.
Probe child reports and parent probes supplied enough byte-level behavior to support an evaluator-passing implementation.
serial_contributors: Single-agent probing and brute-force scans identified enough rules to implement the same behavior.
A large differential corpus exposed the news mismatch, which serial patched before timeout.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel implemented a broader regex-based library model, while serial implemented a simpler direct predicate model.
Serial initially missed the news identity behavior and patched it after differential testing; parallel had already handled it through its fuller rule model.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; process differences did not produce an official pass/fail split

candidates.reason: Parallel parent explicitly owned implementation and wrote all Rust source and entry files; children only characterized behavior.
No independently produced child implementation components required reconciliation; the parent integrated its own modules.
The parent wrote Cargo.toml, test11.rs, and the executable, and artifact validation found the expected entry point.
The parent carried the end-to-end path through probing, implementation, build, differential checks, and delivery despite timeout.
Parent implementation was not blocked behind a single mandatory preflight; it probed, launched workflow, and wrote code before workflow completion.
Investigation and implementation overlapped: child probes ran while the parent implemented and verified, so implementation was not deferred until all investigation ended.
Implementation and correction paths received parent attention and produced a passing artifact; auxiliary child work did not starve indispensable implementation.
The workflow fan-out consumed time and was killed, but no required implementation, integration, or acceptance work was displaced before artifact success.
Children were scoped by API slice or adversarial check; the unfinished parameterize refuter was redundant verification, not an overbroad indispensable child assignment.
The workflow brief included the binary path, line map, known facts, read-only rule, probing expectations, byte behavior, and schema; no known required fact was omitted.
Children returned specifications rather than separately owned code components; no missing file, export, namespace, or compatibility contract produced incompatible work.
No known child or parent finding is shown disappearing through transfer and causing repeated or wrong dependent work.
Child reports were long, but no dependent action was left unfinished because the parent could not reduce their volume within the decision window.
No receiver consumed a superseded workspace, requirement, dependency, or decision-state report that caused rework or invalid verification.
Returned reports did not present unresolved incompatible contracts that blocked or corrupted integration; the titleize example correction did not produce a task mismatch.
The parent did not present a whole-task completion decision before timeout, and local differential plus official evaluation evidence support the artifact.
There was no replacement or retry child repeating prior work without inherited findings; schema corrections occurred inside the same child attempt.

No child was delegated implementation code that the parent failed to retrieve or merge; child work was read-only specification discovery.
Completed verifier-like probe reports reached the journal, and the unfinished adversarial parameterize child did not finalize a concrete finding trapped below the parent.
No required child failure left task work undone; the parent had already implemented and locally verified the corresponding parameterize behavior.
Completed child reports were available, but the parent did not proceed inconsistently with them and no uninspected result caused an adverse task state.
The parent continued implementing, rebuilding, testing, and checking the journal near timeout rather than passively waiting without inspection.
No concurrent child wrote a competing implementation path; children were instructed not to modify files and parent writes were sole-source.
No two live agents edited the same source or configuration file; all /output edits were parent actions.
No agent replaced non-entry source owned by another agent; child agents did not write source files.
The required entry file and executable were produced by the parent without evidence that another live actor owned or overwrote them.
No broad cleanup, rebuild, or promotion invalidated another agent's final-tree work or provenance.
Although the parent wrote the shared workspace, multiple live writing agents are not evidenced, and no unstable-state or provenance problem resulted.
No generated child artifact, cache, temp file, or process was consumed by another actor as stable input or reference environment.
